text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Somebody's gotten inside my head!<n>Betcha this is
the work of a ninja!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It feels all prickly—and sometimes it<n>throbs like ya
wouldn't believe! That<n>ninja's throwin' daggers
right on<n>beat!
choice_data_list: Do you mean you have a headache?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's nothin'! Pain, pain, go away!<n>Don't come
back another day!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is having a hard time<n>dealing with her
headache...
